description: Sentences a read or a call takes out of a value and draws (measured: each drawn, the separators between two items, and `format`'s argument where the class's method wraps it): an item read off an array by its index, and read optionally, an entry off a map, a string a method of its own is called on, the separators a method of an array is handed, called and called optionally, an argument a method of the class is handed, and the argument of `$any`, which the compiler takes off as no call. A call gives what it is called on and what it is handed, the code it calls being free to return either, and no read here follows the code; so the refusal counts eight.
